kpis.description_fr: Cable = Fox News (cœur), FS1, FS2, BTN, FX. Fox News génère ~80 % EBITDA de Fox. Très résilient cord-cutting.
kpis.description_en: Cable = Fox News (core), FS1, FS2, BTN, FX. Fox News drives ~80% of Fox EBITDA. Very resilient to cord-cutting.

kpis.description_fr: Television = Fox Broadcasting + 29 stations Fox + Tubi (streaming AVOD). Cycle politique (US elections) + sports = volatilité.
kpis.description_en: Television = Fox Broadcasting + 29 Fox stations + Tubi (AVOD streaming). Political cycle (US elections) + sports = volatility.

kpis.description_fr: Fox News reste #1 cable news USA depuis 22 ans. Audience prime-time ~2,6 M, total day ~1,3 M. Dominance idéologique conservatrice.
kpis.description_en: Fox News = #1 US cable news for 22 years. Prime time ~2.6M viewers, total day ~1.3M. Conservative ideological dominance.

kpis.description_fr: Tubi MAU ~80 M post-acquisition 2020. AVOD streaming gratuit. Croissance forte = pivot streaming de Fox (vs Disney+/Peacock paid).
kpis.description_en: Tubi MAU ~80M post 2020 acquisition. Free AVOD streaming. Strong growth = Fox's streaming pivot (vs paid Disney+/Peacock).

kpis.description_fr: NFL Sunday games (jusqu'à 2033), MLB (jusqu'à 2028), Big Ten (jusqu'à 2030), NCAA Bowl Series. Pipeline droits sécurisé long terme.
kpis.description_en: NFL Sunday games (through 2033), MLB (through 2028), Big Ten (through 2030), NCAA Bowl Series. Long-term sports rights pipeline secured.

notes: Fox Corporation a un fiscal year se terminant le 30 juin (FY24 = juillet 2023-juin 2024).
